home.heroTitle: Explore the roots of the Arabic language
home.heroSubtitle: A single core of three consonants generates entire families of words. Discover how Arabic morphology builds its lexicon.
home.feature1: Pick three Arabic letters and change them freely to form any root.
home.feature2: Derived words are automatically grouped by type: verbs, masdars, agent nouns and more.
home.feature3: Create, edit and bookmark roots and words to enrich the dictionary.
home.exampleText: From the idea of "writing" come كَاتِب (writer), مَكْتَب (office), كِتَاب (book) and كِتَابَة (writing).

about.title: About the project
about.intro: The Arabic Triliteral Roots Dictionary makes the core mechanism of Arabic morphology tangible: derivation.
about.morphologyText: In Arabic, almost the entire lexicon is built from three-consonant roots to which patterns are applied.
about.audienceText: Arabic language students, teachers, amateur linguists and anyone curious about the language.
